dashboard.label: Training
dashboard.description: Weekly activity, imported Relative Effort and confirmed custom heart-rate zones. Missing effort is unknown; no proprietary fitness or readiness score is inferred. Year grain uses snapshot history; Comparable YTD ends at the import calendar date. Empty charts mean no eligible data in the selection. Automatic selects the first available metric; invalid bookmarked IDs show an explicit unavailable state. Availability is snapshot-wide and refreshes every five minutes.
